audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect flagged the chart, and this side disagreed with the already-written mordekaiser__yorick mirror. Yorick's page read Yorick / Skill / Morde / Morde / Morde / Morde / Morde; the mirror is Skill / Morde / Morde / Morde / Morde / Skill / Yorick. whys[2] and whys[4] also said 'even' while their own side field said Mordekaiser.
audit.why: Level 1 is not a Yorick win — Darkness Rise arms after three hits and Yorick has no reset advantage before graves exist. The lane is Mordekaiser's from 2 through 6 (Death's Grasp on 16s into the isolated Obliterate, Indestructible on 10s undoing chip, Realm of Death at 6). It flips back once Grievous Wounds is bought and the side lane opens, because Realm of Death is a single 100s duel and the Walkers push regardless.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Yorick across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side as one paired group, ratings 5/4/3/3/3/5/6, and every contradicting why line rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named no cooldowns and treated late Mordekaiser as unbeatable.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s — at rank 3 that is one duel per fight, and the side lane with it down is Yorick's strongest state. Executioner's Calling is the real first-item spike here, not Trinity Force, because Indestructible converts every trade into a shield or heal on a 10s cooldown.
audit.corrected: phases[5], phases[6], spikes[3].text, late and whys[5..6] rebuilt around Realm of Death's 100s rank-3 cooldown and the anti-heal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried no ability names and no cooldowns; it said only 'Isolates you from your ghouls'. The _missing feed also asserts 'Mordekaiser can deny your mobility (Mourning Mist E) with Obliterate (Q)' — that is wrong twice over and was NOT written.
audit.why: Mourning Mist is a thrown globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and marks; Riot's text gives Yorick no movement at all (the move speed goes to his summoned units heading toward the mark), so the 'dash' flag in yorick.json is a tooltip-parse misfire. Obliterate's Riot text is a ground smash with no grounding language either, so the 'grounding' flag on it is a second misfire. The real interactions are: Death's Grasp (16/14/12/10/8s, 700 range) pulls you in to set the single-target Obliterate (8/7/6/5/4s, 675 range, free to cast); Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s) stores damage into a shield he can eat for a heal, so chip without Grievous Wounds is refunded; Realm of Death (140/120/100s) takes only Yorick — the Maiden and every Mist Walker stay outside the realm, which is the one spell that beats his whole pattern.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t rewritten with Realm of Death's 140s, Indestructible's 10s and Death's Grasp's 16s, plus the explicit 'Maiden and Walkers stay outside the realm' fact. No dash or grounding claim written anywhere.

audit.why: report[8].t already buys Executioner's Calling early against Indestructible, which is the needs-antiheal item from the _missing feed. Reinforced in breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t so the timing rule reaches the pages a player actually reads mid-lane.

notes: Two kit-flag misfires rejected rather than written. (1) yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) 'dash' — Riot's text is a thrown globule with no movement on Yorick; the move speed goes to his summoned units toward the mark. (2) mordekaiser.json tags Obliterate (Q) 'grounding' — Riot's text is a ground smash with no grounding language. The _missing feed's 'Mordekaiser can deny your mobility with Obliterate' depends on both flags and was therefore not written into any field.
